Let me understand the task: I'm writing section ④ 能力实现途径 under 第二层：技术攻关层——能力实现途径与核心技术. Only this. Target ~1300 chars. Must classify each direction's realization path as 沿用改进 / 集成创新 / 原理突破 and explain selection basis and engineering boundaries.

The report_template_mode is "three_layer_nine_item", not the project-argumentation five-chapter template. So S6入选装备... The instruction says "当本次为项目论证五章模板时，S6 最终入选的武器装备是唯一的装备主体范围" — that's for the other template. Here we're in three_layer_nine_item, so the equipment set is the capability_cues directions (6 directions):

1. "雾蚀"蜂群桨损播撒弹 (P1)
2. 低空航道封锁布雷弹 (P2)
3. 峡谷多径折返拦截弹 (P3)
4. 柔索缠桨拦截无人机 (P4)
5. 阵前预置零延拦射雷 (P5)
6. 展幕缠旋拦阻航弹 (P6)
7. 群站共瞄分布式拦射弹 (P7)

Actually 7 directions. Let me list priorities: P1 雾蚀, P2 布雷弹, P3 峡谷折返弹, P4 柔索缠桨, P5 零延拦射雷, P6 展幕缠旋, P7 群站共瞄.

Note: priority signals seem odd (P1..P7 ordering). I'll use them for ordering lightly but the task is realization path, not priority (that's ⑨). Don't preempt ⑨.

Section map: ④ consumes capability_cues.public_equipment_baseline and capability_cues.development_path. Those fields are empty/absent here. So I must derive realization path from mechanism and portraits, and note evidence limits (baseline unavailable this round — decisive_anchors say public baseline restricted). Don't fabricate.

Each equipment must have its own distinct judgment about whether it lands on the equipment body as 沿用改进 (carrying over/improving existing), 集成创新 (integration innovation), or 原理突破 (principle breakthrough), with selection basis and engineering boundary.

Causal chain per direction: threat → contradiction → target → key action → mechanism → direct result → relative baseline → winning mechanism → opponent counter-adaptation. I use it internally to decide the realization path classification.

Key: distinguishing realization paths must be genuinely different per item, and the落点 must be on the equipment body (装备本体) — i.e., what physically changes on the platform/round.

Let me think through each:

1. 雾蚀蜂群桨损播撒弹 — The carrier is an existing air-defense ammunition / projectile casing; the new part is the dual-function micrometer abrasive+radar-absorbing particle payload and the fuze-timing/wind-field closure. The particles themselves require a new materials formulation (hard-core shell flake particles, bimodal particle size grading, in-round cold dispersal to avoid coating ablation). Baseline: traditional smoke screens only attenuate, chaff/floats only act on radar single channel. So the realization: 原理突破 in the杀伤介质 (media that does mechanical work + EM attenuation simultaneously), but 集成创新/沿用改进 in the delivery platform (existing air-defense ammo, existing radar track and fire scheduling interfaces). Engineering boundary: particle density vs suspension time contradiction; must be deployed on downwind side; wind reversal disables; the dust harms friend too → need no-fly segment output. Also boundary: 悬浮时间 and 消光截面 tunable. And crucially — the round must remain compatible with existing launch/fire-control, so the breakthrough is confined to the payload module + fuze software, not a new launcher. Good: classify as 原理突破（杀伤介质）+ 集成创新（载具与引信闭环）— but instruction says "只判断沿用改进、集成创新或原理突破如何落到装备本体" — so I should pick one primary classification per item and explain, can mention hybrid but be decisive. Let me assign: 雾蚀 → 原理突破落在弹药装填段与引信，载具沿用。

2. 低空航道封锁布雷弹 — Zero-power long-duration station-keeping (sealed float body + attitude control only when drift exceeds), passive magnetic-acoustic fused. Baseline: mortar/rocket dispensers are existing (沿用改进 on the launch layer), but the sub-munition悬定 concept is a new principle (浮体承担重力 vs battery rotor). Realization path: 集成创新 on 抛撒平台 (existing迫击炮/火箭炮不改装), 原理突破 on子弹药浮体悬定与无源触发. Boundary: membrane leak rate, thermal buoyancy drift, wind load swing, tether entanglement; the sensing reliability against low-magnetic shells/unmanned quiet platforms unverified; 自失效与禁区登记 to friendly airspace control.

3. 峡谷多径折返拦截弹 — This is the deepest one: requires弹载多径感知与折转航线联合闭环 + 掠檐折转能量舵效匹配. Traditional proportional navigation line-of-sight. This is 原理突破: treat facade as known reflector, use geometry consistency rather than amplitude thresholds; perception→maneuver→detonation in one online predictive control. Can't be retrofit onto existing interceptors — needs new airframe with folding fins, larger control surfaces, more energy. Baseline: existing单兵/近程拦截弹提供弹体与战斗部, but the guidance loop is a new build. Boundary: needs prior building facade/multipath data; advantage disappears outside canyon; parameters with insufficient public evidence must not be turned into deterministic metrics.

4. 柔索缠桨拦截无人机 — Realization: 集成创新 primarily — new轻型截击机体 uses passive acoustic array + existing airframe + 机背抛射舱/索筒/释放机构. The mechanism (rope entanglement) is old in concept (antenna cable barriers), but closing the loop from无源测向 to抛索时机 on the aircraft is integration + a突破 on机载解算. Let me classify: 集成创新（无源传感—交会—抛索闭环上机）+ 沿用改进（机体与回收再战流程沿用现训）. Boundary: rotor disc exposure and closing relative speed; fixed-wing/high-speed with shrouded coaxial not covered; 坠落二次损伤 needs corridor selection; 饱和 beyond 待战架次.

5. 阵前预置零延拦射雷 — Realization: 原理突破 in交战闭环 (删掉人在环和发现—识别—分配—射击), landing on the equipment body as无源定向探测头 + 储备式供电/电容脉冲 + 一次动作电引爆 + 寿命自诊断. The carrier (定向空炸雷/埋杆) is 沿用改进. So: 原理突破落在引信解算与能量管理，雷体结构与布设沿用工程保障. Boundary: 灵敏度换虚警、束宽换命中密度、值守时长换能量裕度; must register 敌我/民用航路; 自毁; needs多点位冗余抗诱爆.

6. 展幕缠旋拦阻航弹 — Realization: 集成创新 — uses existing火箭/无人机抛撒平台, new payload: 旋转抛撒盘 + 束体预置包装 + 分级配组纤维; plus 计时断丝/光热降解 self-cleaning for friendly use. Some principle novelty in面积拒止 but technically it's packaging + deployment dynamics. Boundary: line density vs kinetic energy vs fall terminal speed contradiction; 阵风 breaks幕; must isolate from friendly rotor areas; 幕存续期 short → 补投.

7. 群站共瞄分布式拦射弹 — Realization: 集成创新 — 弹载红外成像自主截获 (mature component: 小面阵非制冷焦面 + 弹上轻量序列检测) + 无中心错峰抢占协议 + 抗干扰短网 coarse track push. It's an integration/architecture breakthrough: the hardest part is not physics but the network protocol, time sync, IFF consistency, and doctrine (预授权). Baseline: existing光电塔/手持观察组/指挥信息体系 are reused → 集成创新, with 沿用改进 on发射箱和待发弹管理. Boundary: coarse track accuracy must support onboard acquisition; heterogeneous node IFF and time sync consistency; degraded operation when short网 jammed; 夜雾降雨扬尘 degrade imaging.

Now: how to structure the section? Should not use identical opening sentences/paragraph skeletons. Structure should vary by mechanism. Maybe a short lead framing the decision rule (why classify paths by whether the binding constraint is介质, 平台, or闭环), then per-equipment paragraphs. A table might be useful for高密度 comparison but instruction says tables only when each row is different object and each column different judgment function. Given 7 items and ~1300 chars, a compact table could carry the classification while paragraphs carry causal reasoning. But careful: table + prose might duplicate. The contract says 表格每行必须对应不同对象，每列必须承担不同判断功能. That's satisfiable. But 单元格不超过220字, max 6 columns 12 rows. A table with 7 rows × 4 columns (实现途径定位 / 装备本体落点 / 选择依据 / 工程边界) could be clean. However risk: prose then repeats table. Better: write prose per item, and end with a small comparison table? Hmm, target 1300 chars — prose for 7 items at ~180 chars each = 1260. That's tight; adding table pushes over. Overrun allowed ("允许"), but better to be near target.

Maybe group into prose paragraphs: I'll write ~6-7 paragraphs, each covering one equipment, distinct structure. Plus maybe one framing sentence at start (not a header "当前结论"). Let's aim total ~1400-1500 chars. Avoid a table to prevent duplication? The instruction allows but doesn't require. Given 7 items and each needing专属判断, prose is fine. Actually a compact table might aid scanability for the path classification, which is the decision task. But "不得用空表填充" and duplication rule ("同一结论只写一次"). I'll skip the table and write prose, letting each paragraph state classification explicitly with 沿用改进/集成创新/原理突破 labels as required ("能力实现途径明确标注沿用改进/集成创新/原理突破").

Ordering: use the causal grouping rather than P1..P7 sequence to avoid it looking like a priority list (⑨ does priority). But order by实现途径 category? That could be elegant: group by path type. However that risks grouping different equipment with same skeleton. Let me order by physical logic: 弹药介质类 (雾蚀, 展幕), 预置障碍类 (布雷弹, 零延雷), 弹载闭环类 (群站共瞄, 峡谷折返), 平台类 (柔索). Actually grouping by path nature is a good decision-relevant organization: it shows how much of the defense budget goes to payload vs platform vs guidance. But must still give each equipment its专属 judgment. I'll write in that grouped order, with each paragraph its own equipment focus and distinct sentence structure.

Let me also handle the evidence limitation: public baseline for weapons and operational use was not obtained this round (decisive_anchors), so 沿用改进 judgments about existing platforms are stated at capability/class level, not specific model. Must not fabricate model numbers. I can note "现役平台只按级引用" once, briefly, at the end as engineering boundary — but careful about process-placeholder text. Saying "本轮未获得现役装备公开基线，因此凡涉及是否需改装现役发射平台的判断，均按弹药接口层级给出，不落到具体型号" is legitimate evidence-boundary statement, not流程占位.

Terms: avoid English abbreviations; RCS → 雷达反射面积; IFF → 敌我识别; PDF etc n/a. Use Chinese.

Now draft. Target ~1300-1500 Chinese chars.

Paragraph 1 (framing + 雾蚀): 
"能力实现途径的判别，取决于拦不住低慢小的根因落在哪一层：是杀伤介质不够、还是弹药不能长期在场、还是闭环里那道人在环上的延时。" Hmm, framing should be short. Let's put a one-to-two sentence frame then go into 雾蚀 and 展幕.

Draft:

第二层：技术攻关层——能力实现途径与核心技术
④ 能力实现途径

传统低空防空的失效点分布在三层：弹药装填段没有能对旋翼做功的介质，阵地上的火力无法在人不在场时持续存在，指挥链上的秒级闭环追不上末段机动。七项候选方向分别卡在这三层，因此实现途径不能统一按"新造一型装备"处理。

"雾蚀"蜂群桨损播撒弹走原理突破，但突破面只压在装填段与引信解算两处。微米级磨蚀与吸波双功能颗粒要在同一粒径谱里同时满足消光截面与桨面机械损伤，与云团悬浮所需的低密度大比表面积直接冲突，这是现役烟幕与飘条类耗材不具备的功能耦合，无法靠换配方沿用改进得到；工程上采取硬核损壳片状颗粒加双峰粒径配级、弹内冷散布避免涂层烧蚀，把悬浮时间与消光截面做成可调量。发射平台、时间引信与航迹调度接口按现役弹药层级沿用，新增的是把风场估计、起爆时窗与航迹闭合成解算链，并输出友邻禁航段。边界很硬：风向翻转或目标自上风进入时尘幕对己方观测同样生效，该轮即无有效窗口。

展幕缠旋拦阻航弹同样从装填段切入，但它是集成创新。旋转甩出纤维束、抛撒平台、开舱时序都有可借用的成熟件，难点在束体自身的包装与展开动力学：纤维过细则抛出瞬间缠结成团展不开遮挡面积，过粗则下落末速高、悬浮时间撑不住一个批次，弹重与装药还要受火箭和无人机载荷上限约束。攻关落在分级配组束长与线密度、低弯矩卷曲定型、抗静电处理和旋转盘角速度—释放时序—径向初速的匹配上，并须用计时断丝或光热降解让幕体限时自净，否则封锁段把己方旋翼机一并封死。

低空航道封锁布雷弹是平台沿用加子弹药原理突破的组合。迫击炮与火箭抛撒通道不改动，价值全押在"零功耗长期悬定"：密封浮体承担重力、姿控仅在漂移超限时短时修正，这条路线避开了电池驱动旋翼留空以十分钟计的能量死结，代价是膜材微泄漏、温差浮力漂移、风载摆动与系缆缠绕成为新的主要故障源。第二处突破是无源磁—声复合值守触发，探测几乎不耗电且不许主动辐射，须以多物理量联合判据加延时确认把小型无人机同诱饵、鸟群、风噪分开；落装点为上部浮体组件与展开锁定环、弹体下缘传感环与引信安全解算模块。低磁壳体与静音平台的捕获率尚无证据支撑，不得写成确定指标。

阵前预置零延拦射雷把突破点从毁伤挪到交战程序：它删掉的是"发现—识别—分配—射击"这条人在环链条，雷体与埋杆悬置沿用工程保障手段，新增的是顶端护罩内的麦克风阵列与日盲紫外异构事件驱动融合、以到达时间差测向并用旋翼幅度调制设类别门限，使单枚电池覆盖数月值守。起爆侧要解决储备式供电加电容脉冲放电、隔爆链一次动作电引爆、爆轰热冲击下的舱内隔离与寿命自诊断。这里的取舍是三对硬约束：灵敏度换虚警率、破片束宽换命中密度、值守时长换能量裕度。它只在不辐射、不联网的边界内成立，航道不唯一或民用航路未关闭时必须转入延时禁用。

群站共瞄分布式拦射弹是集成创新，也是七项中体系条件最重的一项。弹载非制冷红外成像、序列检测与短网推送都有可用基础，真正的增量是把目标分配从火控排队改为弹自认领：小面阵高分帧频焦面要在角误差大、不含速度的粗航迹误差带内开机即捕获，多弹须在亚秒级形成"谁已认领"的共识，否则并行容量被重复拦射抵消。落点因此一半在导引头窗口与焦面处理组件，一半在扇区边界、判别门限与认领规则的预装定，以及异构节点的敌我识别与时统一致性。链路被压制时须能退化为单节点自主射击，这是集成路线的必配而非选配。

峡谷多径折返拦截弹只能按原理突破立项。它要求弹体把建筑立面当作已知反射面，用目标与虚像的几何一致性而非幅度门限判别，并把航线曲率、可用过载、剩余速度与破片最佳指向收进同一在线预测控制——现役直线追瞄的比例导引与小机动舵面在架构上不支持在不可通行边界内侧连续改向，改装无法给出这条闭环。折叠舵面、掠檐余量与折转吃速决定了它是新研弹体，破片战斗部与发射装置可沿用近程单装。边界是立面与多径特征需要先验，脱离城市峡谷优势即消失。

柔索缠桨拦截无人机走集成创新，机体、弹射待战与回收流程沿用现有轻型无人机做法，突破集中在两件事的上机化：把测向时差混合定位、转速估计与交会解算压进机载任务计算机，使孔径受限的声学阵直接输出抛索触发量与提前量；把索具从收卷状态在极短时间内靠配重带过目标桨盘而不被弹开或磨断，需要展开动力学与缠绕几何的匹配以及抗摩擦升温的索体端部连接。落点为机背抛射舱、索筒与释放机构，并受飞控速度姿态约束。对带护罩共轴目标、高速固定翼与超出待战架次的饱和攻击不成立，仍需既有火力承接。

本轮未取得武器装备与作战运用的公开基线，上述"沿用"均以接口与弹药层级表述，不落到具体现役型号；凡涉及消光截面、悬定时长、捕获概率、无源测向误差等数值，均须在合同试验中给区间与置信度后再定装填与门限。

That's long — let me count roughly. Probably ~1900 chars. Target 1300, overrun allowed but should be reasonable. The instruction says prefer near target; 因果未闭合时可自然略多. 1900 is notably over. I could trim. But there are 7 directions; each needs专属判断. Maybe compress each to ~180-200 chars → ~1400 + framing 100 + closing 100 = 1600. Hmm.

Note: this is a 7-direction set which is large. I'll trim to about 1500-1600. Let me tighten wording, cutting some secondary detail while keeping causal closure (threat → mechanism → result → path choice → boundary).

Actually, wait — should I check whether all 7 are "S6 selected equipment"? The mode is three_layer_nine_item, so the S6 rule doesn't apply. capability_cues directions are the equipment set. Fine.

Let me check the workspace briefly? Not necessary; task is pure writing from given input. No need for tool calls. Actually, maybe I should check if there's anything in the workspace like instructions/AGENTS.md. The sandbox is read-only. A quick ls could confirm nothing else needed. Let me do one quick listing to be safe and cheap.

第二层：技术攻关层——能力实现途径与核心技术

④ 能力实现途径

传统低空防空的失效点分布在三层：装填段缺少能对旋翼做功的介质，阵地火力无法在人在场外持续存在，指挥链的秒级闭环追不上末段机动。七个候选方向分别卡在这三层，因此实现途径不能一律按"新造一型装备"处理，而要看约束究竟绑在弹药、平台还是交战程序上。

"雾蚀"蜂群桨损播撒弹属原理突破，突破面只压在装填段与引信解算两处。微米级磨蚀与吸波双功能颗粒要在同一粒径谱内同时满足消光截面与桨面机械损伤，这与云团悬浮所需的低密度大比表面积直接冲突；现役烟幕只消光、飘条类耗材只作用于单一雷达通道，换配方补不出这重耦合。工程路线取硬核损壳片状颗粒与双峰粒径配级，以弹内冷散布避免涂层烧蚀，把悬浮时间和消光截面做成可调量，发射平台与时间引信按现役弹药接口层级沿用。新增量是把风场估计、起爆时窗与雷达航迹闭合成解算链，并向下风侧之外的友邻输出禁航段——风向翻转或目标改自上风进入时，尘幕对己方观测同样生效，该轮即不构成有效窗口。

展幕缠旋拦阻航弹从同一装填段切入，却是集成创新。旋转抛撒盘、开舱时序、火箭与无人机载运都有可借用的成熟件，难点集中在束体自身的包装与展开动力学：纤维过细则抛出瞬间缠结成团、展不出遮挡面积，过粗则下落末速高、悬浮撑不过一个批次，弹重与装药还要受载运平台上限约束。攻关落在束长与线密度分级配组、低弯矩卷曲定型与抗静电处理，并把盘角速度、释放时序、径向初速匹配成分层展开；幕体对己方旋翼同样致命，须以计时断丝或光热降解限时自净，否则封锁段把自己一并封死。

低空航道封锁布雷弹是抛撒通道沿用、子弹药原理突破的组合。迫击炮与火箭的弹道和发射界面不改动，价值全押在零功耗长期悬定：密封浮体承担重力、姿控单元仅在漂移超限时短时修正，才解开电池驱动旋翼"功率全用于克服重力、留空以十分钟计"的能量死结；代价是膜材微泄漏、温差浮力漂移、风载摆动与系缆缠绕成为主要故障源，落在上部浮体组件与展开锁定环。第二处突破是无源磁—声复合值守触发，几乎不耗电又不许主动辐射，须用多物理量联合判据加延时确认把小型无人机同诱饵、鸟群、风噪分开，落在弹体下缘传感环与引信安全解算模块。低磁壳体与静音平台的捕获率缺证据，不得写成确定门限。

阵前预置零延拦射雷把突破点从毁伤挪到交战程序：它删掉的是"发现—识别—分配—射击"这条人在环链条，雷体与埋杆悬置沿用工程保障手段。真正的攻关是低功耗无源定向确认——麦克风阵列与日盲紫外的异构事件驱动融合，以到达时间差测向、按旋翼幅度调制设类别门限，使单枚电池覆盖数月值守；以及储备式供电加电容脉冲放电、隔爆链一次动作电引爆、爆轰热冲击下舱内隔离与寿命自诊断。取舍是三对硬约束：灵敏度换虚警、破片束宽换命中密度、值守时长换能量裕度。它只在不辐射、不联网的边界内成立，航道不唯一或民用航路未关闭时必须转入延时禁用，且须多点位冗余抗诱爆。

群站共瞄分布式拦射弹属集成创新，也是体系条件最重的一项。非制冷红外成像、序列检测与抗干扰短网推送均可取用现有组件，增量在于把目标分配从火控排队改为弹自认领：导引头要在角误差大、不含速度的粗航迹误差带内开机即捕获，多弹须在亚秒级形成"谁已认领"的共识，否则并行容量被重复拦射抵消。落点一半在导引头窗口与焦面处理组件，一半在扇区边界、判别门限与认领规则的预装定，以及异构光电节点的敌我识别与时统一致。链路被压制时须能退化为单节点自主射击，这是集成路线的必配项而非选配项。

峡谷多径折返拦截弹只能按原理突破立项。它要求弹体把建筑立面当作已知反射面，以目标与虚像的几何一致性而非幅度门限判别，并把航线曲率、可用过载、剩余速度与破片最佳指向收进同一在线预测控制；现役按小机动设计的比例导引与直线追瞄架构，不支持在不可通行边界内侧连续改向，改装给不出这条闭环。折叠舵面与数米级贴檐余量决定其为新研弹体，破片战斗部与发射装置可沿用近程单装层级。成立前提是立面结构与多径特征有先验，脱离城市峡谷后优势消失。

柔索缠桨拦截无人机走集成创新，机体、弹射待战与回收再战流程沿用轻型无人机成熟做法，突破在于两件事的上机化：把测向时差混合定位、转速估计与交会解算压进机载任务计算机，使孔径受限的声学阵直接输出抛索触发量与提前量，不再把发现与授权串在数据链上；以及索具从收卷态在极短时间内靠配重带过桨盘、不被弹开或磨断，需展开动力学与缠绕几何匹配、抗摩擦升温的索体与端部连接，落在机背抛射舱、索筒与释放机构并受飞控速度姿态约束。对带护罩共轴目标、高速固定翼以及超出待战架次的饱和攻击不成立，仍需既有火力承接。

本轮未取得武器装备与作战运用的公开基线，上述"沿用"均以弹药层级与接口关系表述，不落到具体现役型号；消光截面、悬定时长、无源测向误差、截获概率等参数须由合同试验给出区间与置信度后，再定装填量、扇区边界与起爆门限。
